entities.name: Diana Șoșoacă
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Diana Iovanovici Șoșoacă is a Romanian lawyer, activist, and far-right politician. Șoșoacă rose to prominence as an anti-vaccine activist during the COVID-19 pandemic in Romania. She has served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for S.O.S. Romania since her election in 2024.
